Usage: hm set-host [<domain>] [--remove] [--no-database]
Example: hm set-host my-project.local
Description: Set host name in /etc/hosts and core_config_data
Options:
   [-|--remove]     Remove the entry this tool added for the domain, and nothing else
   [-|--no-database] Only touch /etc/hosts, not core_config_data
Arguments:
   <domain>        Domain is desired to set
